description: Open-license stand-in corpus for M0-OWNER-01 (10 rooms + 5 tabletops) sourced from free online videos by Owner decision (2026-09-28) instead of Owner-shot iPhone scans. Media lives only in the private gj-corpus Modal volume under /open-video; never in git.

clips.title: Automated Analysers in a Laboratory
clips.creator: Pavel Danilyuk
clips.attribution_text: "Automated Analysers in a Laboratory" by Pavel Danilyuk on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/automated-analysers-in-a-laboratory-8381327/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Empty modern clinical/science lab; slow lateral slide along a bench row gives strong parallax on equipment, benches and windows; 4K, no people, static scene.
clips.caveats: Short (12 s); glossy white surfaces and big windows may produce specular/over-exposure artefacts.

clips.title: Lush Tropical Conservatory Pathway
clips.creator: Zeynep Urullu
clips.attribution_text: "Lush Tropical Conservatory Pathway" by Zeynep Urullu on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/lush-tropical-conservatory-pathway-35259219/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Indoor garden / glasshouse walkthrough: continuous forward walk along a railed path under a lattice glass dome, then close to a living wall; 4K, 28 s, no people.
clips.caveats: Portrait (2160x3840). Foliage is high-frequency and may sway slightly; bright glass roof is backlit. Handheld walk, some rotation.

clips.title: Reverse tour of a library full of books
clips.creator: Mixkit (no individual credited)
clips.attribution_text: "Reverse tour of a library full of books" from Mixkit (https://mixkit.co/free-stock-video/reverse-tour-of-a-library-full-of-books-21595/) — Mixkit Stock Video Free License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Empty public library: smooth backward dolly between tall bookshelves toward reading tables and chairs; strong parallax, 4K, 21 s, static.
clips.caveats: Repetitive book-spine texture; bright window at the far end. Mixkit Free License item (checked: not Restricted).

clips.title: Church, Cathedral, Catholic
clips.creator: u_na0daok7iv (Pixabay user)
clips.attribution_text: "Church, Cathedral, Catholic" by u_na0daok7iv (Pixabay user) on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/church-cathedral-catholic-368486/) — Pixabay Content License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Chapel/church interior: long, slow stabilised walk down the centre aisle between pews to an ornate gilded altar; 41 s, 1080p60, strong forward parallax.
clips.caveats: Mostly forward motion (less lateral baseline); one or two people may be visible near the altar; stained-glass windows are bright.

clips.title: Modern Art Museum Exhibit with Empty Hallway
clips.creator: Andre Moura
clips.attribution_text: "Modern Art Museum Exhibit with Empty Hallway" by Andre Moura on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/modern-art-museum-exhibit-with-empty-hallway-35251011/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Empty art gallery: slow forward dolly through a white-walled room hung with framed works; wood floor and frames give good features; 4K, no people.
clips.caveats: Short (11 s); glass over the frames reflects; white walls are texture-poor.

clips.title: Video of a Music Studio
clips.creator: RDNE Stock project
clips.attribution_text: "Video of a Music Studio" by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/video-of-a-music-studio-8197913/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Recording studio control room: slow push-in with lateral drift toward a large mixing console, monitors and speakers; rich geometry, warm lighting, no people.
clips.caveats: 1080p, 10 s; dim, warm light; screens show changing content (small dynamic regions).

clips.title: Modern Minimalist Living Room Interior Design
clips.creator: Fernanda Neitzel
clips.attribution_text: "Modern Minimalist Living Room Interior Design" by Fernanda Neitzel on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/modern-minimalist-living-room-interior-design-34237010/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Home living/dining room (Movement Bible furniture classes): steady lateral walk past a sofa with cow-hide rug to a round dining table with chairs under a sloped wood ceiling; 4K.
clips.caveats: Portrait, under 10 s; lateral pass only (no second height).

clips.title: Furniture, Store, Room
clips.creator: NTbk (Pixabay user)
clips.attribution_text: "Furniture, Store, Room" by NTbk (Pixabay user) on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/furniture-store-room-home-interior-212213/) — Pixabay Content License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Large furniture showroom: slow lateral dolly across many sofas, armchairs, coffee tables, shelving and lamps; dense couch/coffee-table/chair content; static, no people.
clips.caveats: 1080p, 10 s; large open space so far background is small in frame.

clips.title: Minimal Kitchen Interior
clips.creator: RDNE Stock project
clips.attribution_text: "Minimal Kitchen Interior" by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/minimal-kitchen-interior-8581127/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Home kitchen: handheld/gimbal walk around an island from the dining side to the counter run; good translation and full-room coverage; 21 s, no people.
clips.caveats: 1080p; white cabinets are low-texture and stainless steel is reflective.

clips.title: An Empty Coffee Shop Interior
clips.creator: Connor Scott McManus
clips.attribution_text: "An Empty Coffee Shop Interior" by Connor Scott McManus on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/an-empty-coffee-shop-interior-14227022/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Cafe/bakery-style interior: slow walk past a window bar with stools into the seating area and service counter; 4K60, 15 s, empty.
clips.caveats: Portrait; large bright windows on one side (exposure swing).

clips.title: Full tour of ESO's Paranal Observatory in miniature (LEGO model)
clips.creator: F. Snik/Leiden University/ESO
clips.attribution_text: "Full tour of ESO's Paranal Observatory in miniature (LEGO model)" — Credit: F. Snik/Leiden University/ESO. Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Source: https://www.eso.org/public/videos/ann17038b/. Trimmed (first 64.9 s).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: LEGO build on a table: a large LEGO model of the Paranal observatory filmed with slow sliding/arc camera moves at low and high angles; 4K UHD; static model.
clips.caveats: TRIMMED: first 64.9 s of the 134.5 s original (stream copy, no re-encode, audio dropped); contains 2 cuts (about 23.6 s and 36.8 s), all of the same static model. ESO policy: credit line mandatory and visible; do not imply ESO endorsement. LEGO is a trademark (not a copyright concern for internal testing).

clips.title: Close Up of Chess Pieces
clips.creator: RDNE Stock project
clips.attribution_text: "Close Up of Chess Pieces" by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/close-up-of-chess-pieces-7977562/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Chess set on a table: slow slide across a board of sculpted fantasy chess pieces; many distinct small objects with parallax; static.
clips.caveats: 1080p, 14 s; shallow depth of field (background soft); coverage from one side only.

clips.title: Tracking Shot of an Assortment of Glass Bottles
clips.creator: RDNE Stock project
clips.attribution_text: "Tracking Shot of an Assortment of Glass Bottles" by RDNE Stock project on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/tracking-shot-of-an-assortment-of-glass-bottles-8903508/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Glass/crystal tabletop: lateral tracking shot across a group of tinted glass bottles and vases on a table; deliberately hard transparent/refractive stress case.
clips.caveats: Under 9 s; 1080p; transparent and refractive objects are a known splat failure mode (use as a stress test).

clips.title: Tank, Military, Miniature
clips.creator: Matias_Luge (Pixabay user)
clips.attribution_text: "Tank, Military, Miniature" by Matias_Luge (Pixabay user) on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/tank-military-miniature-model-197427/) — Pixabay Content License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Miniature diorama: a painted scale-model tank in a snow scene with tiny trees, filmed with a smooth arc/orbit around it; 4K; closest to a true tabletop orbit in the set.
clips.caveats: 13 s; about a 90-degree arc, not a full 360; snow is bright and low-texture.

clips.title: Tracking Shot of a Chinese Tea Set
clips.creator: Supercreat Huang
clips.attribution_text: "Tracking Shot of a Chinese Tea Set" by Supercreat Huang on Pexels (https://www.pexels.com/video/tracking-shot-of-a-chinese-tea-set-10326734/) — Pexels License (attribution not required, given as courtesy).
clips.why_good_for_reconstruction: Pottery/ceramics on a table: 47 s slow lateral dolly along a traditional tea set (tea caddy, cups, gaiwan) on a bamboo mat on a wood table.
clips.caveats: 1080p; very shallow depth of field and close framing; a printed card with text is on the table.
